    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AdministratorPrivileges
    Checks effective process elevation on Windows or effective root identity on Unix systems.
    App
    Defines the process entry point and the current initialize-and-inspect application sequence.
    ARG
    Declares the immutable identity, data class and constraints of one supported argument.
    ArgClass
    Identifies the data representation required when transforming a textual argument value.
    ArgsList
    Indexes supported argument declarations and exposes their environment bindings and effective-value schema.
    ArgType
    Distinguishes flags, named parameters, definitions and positional targets.
    ArgumentAccess
    Reads indexed parameter occurrences without interpreting their data types or executing application actions.
    ArgumentConstraints
    Applies ARG constraints using reusable numeric and filesystem validation services.
    ArgumentDefinitionsValidator
    Checks loaded CLI names and multiplicity against the declarations accepted by the application.
    ArgumentException
    Carries a controlled diagnostic key for an invalid application argument.
    Arguments
    Stores syntax-only command-line data in indexed name/value lists, preserving occurrence order.
    ArgumentTransformer
    Selects reusable text conversions from ARG metadata and translates conversion failures to diagnostic keys.
    ArgumentValidator
    Validates supported working values and constraints before preparing declared filesystem paths.
    CommandLineArguments
    Applies explicit CLI values and reconciles remaining environment entries with supported argument declarations.
    CommandLineLoader
    Loads CLI syntax during construction and aborts locally on malformed tokens, without consulting the argument schema.
    ConsoleSink
    Formats and filters console messages while preserving borrowed output streams.
    Context
    Holds one single-threaded execution state, borrowed console streams and immutable original target selections.
    ContextSummary
    Prints the temporary console-only view of effective execution values and target selections.
    ContextValidator
    Publishes validated application values and resolves targets, aborting initialization on known failures.
    EnvironmentArguments
    Reads uppercase environment bindings using the selected prefix and preserves unclassified values for later reconciliation.
    ExternalConfiguration
    Loads one external TOML layer into textual working arguments without provisioning machines.
    FileLogSink
    Persists UTF-8 events without console colors in an exclusively created execution log.
    Help
    Renders localized CLI help as plain text, preserving spacing and obtaining its version from build metadata.
    InitializationMessages
    Reports application initialization diagnostics and terminates failed initialization with the accumulated return code.
    Initializer
    Coordinates configuration layers in precedence order and returns the validated singleton context.
    InternalConfiguration
    Applies optional bundled TOML defaults before external files, environment values and CLI overrides.
    LogEvent
    Carries immutable event metadata and sanitized text shared by all output backends.
    Logger
    Localizes and sanitizes events before distributing them to persistent and console sinks.
    Loggers
    Composes the default console and file backends without depending on application state.
    LogSink
    Accepts sanitized events through a backend-neutral output contract.
    MessageCatalog
    Resolves localized message templates using an explicit resource bundle and locale.
    MessageDefinition
    Describes a localized event independently of its logging backend.
    OperationResult<T>
    Combines optional operation data with an explicit return-code mask, without inferring status from messages.
    PathValidation
    Checks filesystem object types and prepares missing paths when their policy permits creation.
    Platform
    Describes host OS and runtime properties without claiming virtualization capabilities.
    Platform.Family
    Groups recognized operating systems while retaining an explicit unknown case.
    RC
    Defines composable IASI return-code bits without deciding execution flow.
    Severity
    Associates message severity with console presentation colors.
    SingleInstanceLock
    Owns an exclusive NIO instance lock independently of executable names and application policy.
    SingleInstanceLock.BusyException
    Distinguishes an active instance from I/O or permission failures during acquisition.
    TargetDiscovery
    Discovers immediate machine directories with a direct configuration-directory marker, without reading configuration contents or interpreting selection patterns.
    TargetValidator
    Matches original regular expressions against discovered target names without modifying the original patterns.
    TargetValidator.Selection
    Separates immutable selected paths from original patterns that matched no target.
    TomlConfiguration
    Reads TOML sources into textual arguments and applies the same layer rules to internal and external configuration.
    ValueConstraintException
    Distinguishes a violated value constraint from an unparseable lexical value.
    ValueConstraints
    Checks numeric bounds and positive-integer constraints independently of CLI definitions.
    ValueConversion
    Converts textual values to reusable Java types, using ISO date and time formats.
    Verbosity
    Names console visibility levels independently of application commands.
    WorkingArguments
    Accumulates textual configuration layers and keeps unclassified environment values separate until reconciliation.
